title: S205--FY27 Solid Waste Collection Services
agency: VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF > VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF > 248-NETWORK CONTRACT OFFICE 8 (36C248)
description:
SOLICITATION DESCRIPTION

The VA Caribbean Healthcare System (VACHS), 10 Casia St, San Juan, PR 00921, has a requirement for Solid Waste Collection Services. Services will include solid waste and recyclable waste collection services at various locations of the VACHS, to include the main facility at San Juan, PR, its Carolina Warehouse, and its Mayaguez Out-patient Clinic (MOPC).
Collection services include four (4) electric compactors (three at VACHS and one at MOPC), in addition to four open-top dumpsters at VACHS, and two open-top dumpsters at the Carolina Warehouse.
The Contractor shall have the resources necessary for the provision these services. Waste Collection services include the collection of Recyclable Waste, which is composed of wooden pallets, aluminum, plastic, and vegetative waste.
North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code for this requirement is 62111 (Solid Waste Collection), and the Product Service Code (PSC) is S205 (Housekeeping   Trash/Garbage Collection).

Government will award a contract resulting from this solicitation to the responsible Quoter whose quote conforming to the solicitation will be most advantageous to the Government, price and other factors considered. The following factors will be used to evaluate quotes:
1. Technical Capability: The technical submission will primarily determine the qualifications and capability of the quoter to participate in this contract. It should be specific and complete in every detail.
The submission should be concise and provide sufficient information to demonstrate the quoter s capacity to satisfactory perform the task(s) outlined in the solicitation.
Content of technical submission - The technical submission shall include at a minimum:
i. A technical approach that details how the requirements of the PWS will be accomplished.
ii. Sufficient documentation (including brochures, pamphlets, product literature, etc.), to allow thorough evaluation of the quote.
iii. Demonstrate the ability to meet the requirements in the solicitation as stated in the PWS.
iv. Vendor must also submit the following:
- License to transport and dispose of Solid Waste in the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico, provided by the Puerto Rico Department of Natural Resources.
- Permit to dispose of Solid Waste in Puerto Rico landfills.
- Department of Transportation (DOT) permit for vehicles transporting Solid Waste.
2. Past Performance: The past performance submissions will primarily determine the competency of the quoter s historical performance, and how that competency can be employed to predict the quoter s success in performing the task(s) listed in the solicitation.
Content of Past Performance Submittal - The past performance shall include at a minimum:
i. A list of Points of Contact (POCs) for two current or previous contracts and/or agreements you have with other public or private firms for the type of work included in this solicitation.
ii. This information should include name, email address, and telephone number.
3. Price: The pricing submission will primarily inform the Government as to the prices the vendor can perform the work in accordance with the solicitation.

Questions submission shall be received not later than 12:00 PM Atlantic Standard Time (AST) on November 20, 2026 at wilfredo.perez3@va.gov.
Submission of your response shall be received not later than 12:00 PM AST on December 1, 2026 at wilfredo.perez3@va.gov. The quoter shall submit a PDF version of the quote to the Government. Late submissions shall be treated in accordance with the solicitation provision at FAR 52.212-1(c). Omission of any one item MAY result in a quoter package being deemed not technically acceptable.
Basis for Award. The Government will issue a contract to the responsible quoter whose quotation conforming to the solicitation will be most advantageous to the Government, price and other factors considered.
